queries.query: Ternopil Ukraine official cadastral parcel map GIS land registry viewer
queries.result: First-party results identified the Ternopil City Council municipal GIS/open-data route, the regional StateGeoCadastre office, Ukraine's official NSDI parcel-search documentation, and the state urban-planning geoportal. The municipal open-data description says the Ternopil urban-planning cadastral geoportal provides geospatial data and planning documentation. No safe anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was obtained.

registryEvidence.scopeNote: The municipal source is the local custodian route. The regional StateGeoCadastre page is recorded as state cadastral context, not as proof of a local parcel API.
